description: This source file defines an enum called LaunchdManager that manages launchd services via the launchctl command. It includes methods to start and stop a specific OpenClaw process by interacting with launchd.

classes.name: LaunchdManager
classes.description: An enum providing static methods to control launchd services related to OpenClaw.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Executes a launchctl command with given arguments to control launchd.

methods.name: startOpenClaw
methods.description: Starts the OpenClaw service via launchctl.

methods.name: stopOpenClaw
methods.description: Stops the OpenClaw service via launchctl.
